description: Tool to retrieve availability schedules configured for a specific Calendly event type. Use when you need to get the availability rules including day-of-week schedules and date-specific overrides.

inputSchema.description: Request to retrieve availability schedules for a specific Calendly event type.

event_type.description: URI of the event type whose availability schedules are to be listed. Must be a valid Calendly event type URI. Retrieve this URI from calendly.list_event_types; using a URI not owned by the authenticated user returns a 403 error.
event_type.title: Event Type

user.description: URI of the user associated with the event type. Optional parameter to filter by user.
user.title: User

inputSchema.title: GetEventTypeAvailabilityRequest

name: get_event_type_availability

AvailabilityRule.description: Rule defining availability for a specific day or date.

date.description: Specific date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) when type is 'date'. Example: '2025-08-05'.
date.title: Date

intervals.description: Array of time intervals defining when the event type is available during the specified day or date.
intervals.title: Intervals

type.description: The type of availability rule: 'wday' for weekday-based rules or 'date' for specific date rules.
type.title: Type

wday.description: Day of the week when type is 'wday'. Values: 'sunday', 'monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday'.
wday.title: Wday

AvailabilityRule.title: AvailabilityRule

AvailabilityRuleWrapper.description: Wrapper containing the timezone and availability rules.

name.description: Name of the availability schedule (may be null).
name.title: Name

rules.description: Array of availability rule objects that define when the event type is available.
rules.title: Rules

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the availability schedule (e.g., 'Europe/London', 'America/New_York').
timezone.title: Timezone

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the user availability schedule resource.
uri.title: Uri

AvailabilityRuleWrapper.title: AvailabilityRuleWrapper

availability_rule.description: Availability rule configuration containing timezone, user, URI, and rules for when the event type is available.
availability_rule.title: Availability Rule

event_type.description: URI reference to the event type.
event_type.title: Event Type

GetEventTypeAvailabilityResponse.description: Response containing the availability schedules for the specified event type.

collection.description: Array containing the event type availability schedule resources.
collection.title: Collection

GetEventTypeAvailabilityResponse.title: GetEventTypeAvailabilityResponse

Pagination.description: Pagination information for navigating through multiple pages of results.

count.description: The number of items returned in the current page. Maximum value is 100.
count.title: Count

next_page.description: The URL to retrieve the next page of results. Null if there are no more pages.
next_page.title: Next Page

next_page_token.description: Token used for cursor-based pagination to retrieve the next page. Null if there are no more pages.
next_page_token.title: Next Page Token

previous_page.description: The URL to retrieve the previous page of results. Null if this is the first page.
previous_page.title: Previous Page

previous_page_token.description: Token used for cursor-based pagination to retrieve the previous page. Null if this is the first page.
previous_page_token.title: Previous Page Token

Pagination.title: Pagination

TimeInterval.description: Time interval defining when availability exists.

from.description: Start time of the availability interval in 24-hour format (HH:MM), e.g., '09:00'.
from.title: From

to.description: End time of the availability interval in 24-hour format (HH:MM), e.g., '17:00'.
to.title: To

TimeInterval.title: TimeInterval
